# PageTemplate

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

A page template: given the 1-based page number, the element to draw in a page-chrome slot on that page, or nothing.

The type of `headerTemplate`, `footerTemplate`, `pageBackground` and `pageForeground`. A hand-written function satisfies it, and so does the result of [`pageTemplate`](page-template.md).

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
type PageTemplate = (pageNumber: number) => IElement | undefined
```
